phantom.label: A staircase the Borg was not standing on
phantom.explanation: A young Borg in munchkin mode stands on plain floor and remembers a down staircase one diagonal step to the north-west - the grid the adjacent-monster scan examines last. A sealed stair in a permanent-wall pocket keeps the stair flows failing so the decision reaches the take-the-stair tests. The original tests the neighbours feature through the stale pointer and queues the take-stair key while standing on floor; in the game that keypress fails without taking a turn, so the Borg can repeat the same decision forever. The correction reads the Borgs own grid and the phantom keypress disappears.

on-stair.label: Control: standing on a real staircase
on-stair.explanation: The same young Borg stands on a real, seen down staircase. The power-diving section takes it correctly before the scan runs, and the complete log is byte-identical before and after the correction: the fix removes only the phantom keypress, not legitimate stair-taking.
